narrative: Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling, southbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the left turn lane, north of Embassy Blvd. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling northbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the right turn lane, north of Embassy Blvd. Driver 1 proceeded to make a left turn into a nearby parking lot access, but failed to yield to oncoming V02. As a result, the front of V01 collided with the left side of V02. Driver 2 lost control of V02 and traveled off of the roadway, whereby V02 collided with a ditch, and remained at final rest. V01 remained at final rest, facing northeast in the right turn lane of U.S. 19.

V1 was exiting the parking lot of Enterprise rental car and proceeded east across 3 SB lanes of traffic. In doing so, violated the ROW of V2, causing a collision with the front of V2 and the DS of V1. This impact caused V2 to go over the solid median, into the NB lanes of US19. As V2 entered the NB lanes, V2 collided head on with V3, a motorcycle.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling southbound in the left turn lane on US Highway 19, south of Flora Avenue. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling northbound in the right turn lane on US Highway 19, also south of Flora Avenue. As V01 was making a left turn, Driver 1 failed to observe V02 traveling northbound. As a result, the front-right of V01 collided with the left side of V02. Both vehicles were moved from the roadway prior to my arrival.

V01 was traveling westbound out of the parking lot of [ADDRESS] approaching Collier Pkwy. V02 was traveling northbound on Collier Pkwy approaching the intersection of [ADDRESS] When Driver of V01 proceeded into the intersection while it was not clear to do so. As a result the front bumper of V01 collided with the front right of V02. Both vehicles were removed from the area of collision prior to my arrival.

V01 was traveling east on Bonita Road approaching US 19 (State Road 55). NM1 was walking east from the southbound shoulder of US 19 (State Road 55) in a marked crosswalk just south of Bonita Road. Driver 1 stated he observed a green traffic signal and initiated a right turn onto US 19 (State Road 55) into the outside lane. NM1 stated he activated the crosswalk signal and on observance of a walk signal, began to cross the southbound lanes of US 19 (State Road.) As a result of the actions of Driver 1 and and NM1, the driver's side front corner of V01 collided with the left side of NM1 knocking him to the ground. V01 was moved from final rest prior to my arrival. NM1 was transported off the scene by EMS prior to my arrival. Due to conflicting statements and lack of any video surveillance the at fault party can not be found.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling eastbound on Sunray Drive, in the left turn lane, at U.S. 19 (State Road 55). Vehicle 2 (V02) was stopped, southbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the left turn lane, at Sunray Drive. Driver 1 stated that as he turned left onto northbound U.S. 19, V01 began to hydroplane, and rotate counterclockwise. It rotated back across the center median of U.S. 19. As a result, the rear right portion of V01 collided with the front left portion of V02. Both vehicles were relocated to a nearby parking lot, upon my arrival.

Vehicle 01 was traveling north on US Hwy 19 approaching Fox Hollow Drive in the inside lane. Vehicle 02 was traveling south on US Hwy 19 approaching Fox Hollow Drive in the left turn lane. Driver 01 failed to observe the steady red while approaching Fox Hollow Drive as V02 had the steady green arrow. As a result, the front of V01 collided with the right front side of V02. After collision, both V01 and V02 came to final rest in the roadway.

Vehicle 1, (V01) was traveling eastbound on Osowaw Blvd in the inside left turn lane making a left turn onto US-19 (SR-55). Vehicle 2, (V02) was traveling westbound on Spring Hill Dr attempting to cross the intersection of US-19 (SR-55). Driver 1 stated he made his left turn on a solid green arrow. Driver 2 stated as she was crossing the intersection the traffic signal turned yellow. As a result, the front of Vehicle 1 struck the left rear of Vehicle 2. Vehicle 1 and Vehicle 2 were moved from the roadway prior to my arrival. After completing my on scene investigation I checked for any witnesses and security cameras that might have seen the incident to help identify the at fault party but was unsuccessful. Due to conflicting statements, lack of independent witnesses and physical evidence no citations were issued.

Vehicle-1 (V01) was eastbound in the outside left turn lane of Osowaw Boulevard approaching a steady green traffic signal at the intersection of US Highway 19. Vehicle-2 (V02) was westbound on Spring Hill Drive approaching a steady green traffic signal at the intersection of US Highway 19. Driver-1 (D01) attempted to make a left turn onto US Highway 19 and crossed into the direct path of V02. The front right of V01 then struck the left rear side of V02. After the collision, both V01 and V02 were relocated to the CVS parking lot on the northwest corner of the intersection. D01 was cited for failure to yield and driving while license suspended unknowingly.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling eastbound on Moog Road, approaching U.S. 19 (State Road 55). Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling northbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the inside lane, approaching Moog Road. Driver 2 faced a green traffic light and entered the intersection. Driver 1 faced a red traffic light and entered the intersection, failing to stop. As a result, the front of V02 collided with the rear right and undercarriage of V01. Both vehicles were removed from the roadway, prior to my arrival.

Vehicle 1 (V01) with trailer (T01) was traveling west on State Road 54, east of the intersection for Lowe's Home Improvement, in the left turn lane. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling east on State Road 54, west of the intersection for Lowe's Home Improvement, in the __ lane. Vehicle 3 (V03) was stationary northbound from the Lowe's Home Improvement, south of State Road 54, in the outside left turn lane. V02 had a green circular traffic signal and proceeded through the intersection. V01 had a flashing yellow arrow traffic signal and entered the intersection to turn left. V01 failed to yield to V02. Consequently, V01's right collided with V02's front. The force of the collision caused V01 to rotate counter-clockwise and V02 to rotate clockwise. Subsequently, V01's right rear collided with V02's left. V01 continued in a southeast direction. The Driver of V03 (D03) observed the collision and travel of vehicles and was attempting to back up to avoid the collision but was unable to. Consequently, V01's front right collided with V03's front right. V01 came to a final rest facing south in the northbound lanes from the Lowes Home Improvement parking lot. V02 came to a final rest facing south in the intersection. V03 relocated to the front area of V01 to allow traffic to flow.

V01 was traveling west in the private driveway of [ADDRESS] 54, New [NAME] Richey, FL, approaching the intersection of Collier Parkway. V02 was traveling south in the outside lane on Collier Parkway, approaching the intersection of State Road 54. V01 began to travel west from the private driveway across the north and southbound lanes of Collier Parkway. Driver - 1 failed to observe V02 traveling south on Collier Parkway and the front right of V01 struck the front of V02. Both vehicles came to final rest at the area of collision in the southbound lanes of Collier Parkway and remained at final rest upon Trooper's arrival. Contributing Cause - Driver - 1 failed to yield to oncoming traffic from a private driveway to avoid a collision.

V1 was traveling eastbound while exiting the 7-11 gas station parking lot to initiate a left turn onto S Mt Carmel Rd. V2 was traveling northbound, in the right turn lane, on S Mt Carmel Rd approaching the area of the 7-11. V3 was traveling northbound in the center lane, adjacent to V2, on S Mt Carmel Rd approaching the area of the 7-11. V1 struck V2 on the left rear side of V2 with the front of V1. After striking V2, V1 struck the right rear of V3's trailer in tow. V2 was disabled and required a tow. V2-D2 complained of left shoulder pain and was transported to Tampa General Hospital for further evaluation. V1-D1 related the following: He was pulling out of the gas station to turn left. He did not see anyone coming. He drove forward and the truck hit the front of his car. He thinks the other truck was speeding because he looked both ways and didn't see it coming. V2-D2 related the following: He was driving north on S Mt Carmel Rd when a truck pulling out of the 7-11 parking lot shot out and crashed into the side of his truck. V3-D3 related the following: He did not see the initial crash, he heard it. When he looked back he noticed the bumper of the blue truck got caught on the side of his trailer and came off.

Vehicle 1 was traveling north in the Wendy's parking lot located at [ADDRESS]. Non-Motorist 1 was walking south in the Wendy's parking lot located at [ADDRESS]. Driver 1 failed to observe Non-Motorist walking through the parking lot. As a result, the front left of Vehicle 1 struck Non-Motorist 1. Driver 1 then fled the scene in Vehicle 1 traveling towards U.S. Highway 19. Upon Trooper's arrival, Non-Motorist 1 was transported to Regional Medical Center Bayonet Point. Driver 1 and Vehicle 1 were not on scene. Non-Motorist 1 advised that Vehicle 1 was a gray Chevrolet SUV bearing Florida [PLATE] (INHS). A CIC query revealed there were no records found. This investigation is pending further information regarding Driver 1 and Vehicle 1.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling southbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the center lane, approaching State Road 52. Vehicle 2 (V02) was stopped at a red traffic light, southbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the center lane, at State Road 52. Vehicle 3 (V03) was stopped, southbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the outside lane, at State Road 52. Driver 1 stated that he was tired and distracted, and that he "didn't realize that they were stopped until the last second", thus failing to stop for V02 and V03. Driver 1 did attempt to brake, and in doing so, maneuvered V01 such that it straddled the lane line. The front of V01 collided with the right rear of V02 and the rear of V03, simultaneously. All three vehicles were removed from the roadway, upon my arrival.

V01 was traveling south on US HWY 19 in the #3 lane, stopped at a steady red signal. V02 was traveling north on US HWY 19 in the left hand turn lane to go west on Innisbrook Dr with a steady green turn arrow. As V02 was making the left hand turn and was traveling through the intersection, V01 proceeded through its steady red signal and collided with V02. V01's front bumper area collided with V02's back right tire. V01 and V02 both came to final rest on Innisbrook Dr.

V01 was traveling south on N Parsons Ave approaching the intersection of N Parsons Ave and SR-60 in the left turn lane. V02 was traveling north on N Parsons Ave approaching the intersection of N Parsons Ave and SR-60 in the northbound lane. V01 had a flashing left yellow signal. V02 had a steady green light. V01 failed to yield to V02. As a result, V01 proceeded to turn left at the intersection, causing the front of V01 to strike the right fender of V02. V01 came to final rest facing south at the intersection of N Parsons Ave and SR-60. V02 came to final rest facing north at the intersection of N Parsons Ave and SR-60. Both vehicles were off the roadway upon my arrival. No surface marks were observed on the roadway.

Vehicle-1 was traveling north on US 19 North (State Road 55) in the outside lane, approaching County Road 880 (Klosterman Road). Vehicle-2 was traveling north on US 19 North (State Road 55) in the outside lane, approaching County Road 880 (Klosterman Road) ahead of Vehicle-1. Vehicle-1 collided with the rear left of Vehicle-2 with the front right of Vehicle-1. Vehicle-1 and Vehicle-2 were both removed from area of impact and final rest prior to my arrival. Vehicle-1 and Vehicle-2 was both parked on the northbound shoulder, south of the intersection upon my arrival.

Vehicle 01 (V01) was traveling east in the inside eastbound lane of County Road 595 (Osowaw Blvd), approaching US Highway 19 North (State Road 55). Vehicle 02 (V02) was traveling west in the westbound lane of County Road 574 (Spring Hill Drive), approaching US Highway 19 North (State Road 55). According to witnesses, the left turn arrow for vehicles facing east on County Road 595 (Osowaw Blvd) was solid red. Westbound traffic on County Road 574 (Spring Hill Drive) faced a green-lit traffic signal to travel west. The driver of V01 (D01) turned left from the eastbound through lane and began to travel northbound at US Highway 19 North (State Road 55) in front of V02, who was traveling lawfully through the intersection. As a result, the front of V02 collided with the passenger side of V01. Both vehicles moved from the area of collision and relocated facing north on the outside northbound shoulder of US Highway 19 North (State Road 55) north of County Road 574 (Spring Hill Drive).

Vehicle 1 was traveling south in the parking lot address of [ADDRESS], northwest of Vehicle 2. Vehicle 2 was traveling west in the parking lot address of [ADDRESS], southeast of Vehicle 2. Vehicle 1 turned left (southeast). The left side of Vehicle 1 struck the left side of Vehicle 2. Vehicle 1 and 2 pulled into parking spaces.

V1 was traveling east on Brandon Blvd., in the # 3 lane, approaching the intersection with S Parsons Ave. V2 was at the red light on S Parsons Ave., attempting to turn west on Brandon Blvd. The driver of V2 advised he had a green arrow and proceeded through the intersection when the front bumper of V1 struck the rear left quarter panel of V2. The crash was captured on surveillance cameras from a nearby business which showed all of the east bound traffic come to a stop as the light was red, which allowed V2 to enter the intersection. The video showed V1 run the red light and strike V2 in the intersection. The break lights of V1 did not illuminate prior to the collision. Copies of the video were later impounded into evidence. The driver of V1 was cited for failure to obey a traffic control device.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling west in the inside left turn lane on State Road 50 (Cortez Boulevard), east of County Road 587 (Mariner Boulevard) with a steady red traffic light. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling east in the center lane on State Road 50 (Cortez Boulevard), west of County Road 587 (Mariner Boulevard) with a steady green traffic light. Vehicle 3 (V03) was stationary in the inside left turn lane on County Road 587 (Mariner Boulevard), south of State Road 50 (Cortez Boulevard) with a steady red traffic light. Driver-1 initiated to make a left turn to travel into County Road 587 (Mariner Boulevard). Driver-1 failed to yield the right of way to V02. As a result, the front of V02 struck the right side of V01. V01 rotated counter clockwise and the left rear of V01 struck the right front of V03. V01 came to final rest facing north in the intersection of State Road 50 (Cortez Boulevard) and County Road 587 (Mariner Boulevard). V02 came to final rest facing west in the intersection of State Road 50 (Cortez Boulevard) and County Road 587 (Mariner Boulevard). V03 came to final rest facing north in the inside left turn lane on County Road 587 (Mariner Boulevard).

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling south on U.S. Highway 19 just south of State Road 52 in the left turn lane. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling noth on U.S. Highway 19 in the right turn lane just south of State Road 52. V01 began to make a left turn into the La Vista Inn parking lot located at [ADDRESS] entering the path of V02 resulting in the front end of V02 striking the right side of V01. All vehicles were moved from final rest prior to my arrival. There were no skid marks found on scene.

V01 was traveling westbound on State Road 52 in the inside left turn lane approaching US Highway 19(State Road 55). V02 was traveling northbound on US Highway 19(State Road 55) in the inside left turn lane approaching State Road 52. V02 came to a complete stop in traffic. Driver-1 made a left turn to enter the inside lane on southbound US 19 and lost control of V01, which resulted in V01 crossing the center median in a south east direction. As a result, the front right of V01 struck the left front side of V02. V01 came to final rest in the area of collision facing east on US Highway 19 south of State Road 52. V02 came to final rest in the area of collision facing north on US Highway 19 south of State Road 52. Contributing Cause- Driver-1 lost control of V01 while making a left turn causing a collision with another vehicle.

V01 was traveling eastbound on State Road 60, approaching the intersection of Mount Carmel Road. V02 was traveling westbound in the left turn lane on State Road 60, approaching the intersection of Mount Carmel Road. The traffic signal for east and westbound lanes was steady red. The left turn signal was steady green. Driver-2 stated the light turn green and she was making a left turn when V01 came and hit her. The right side of V02 was struck by the right front end of V01. V02 came to final rest in the intersection facing northwest. V01 was moved to the grass center median prior to my arrival.

V01 was traveling south on US 19 (State Road 55) approaching Sunray Drive to a red traffic signal. V02 was traveling east on Sunray Drive approaching US 19 (State Road 55) in the left turn lane to a green traffic signal. Driver 2 initiated a left turn and entered into the intersection. Driver 1 failed to observe the red signal and traveled south into the intersection. As a result, the passenger's side front corner of V01 collided with the driver's side front corner of V02. V01 was witnessed fleeing the scene traveling south on US 19 (State Road 55) and turned on to Darlington Road and traveled into an unknown location. V02 came to final rest on southbound US 19 (State Road 55) just south of the intersection of Sunray Drive in the center lane facing in a southerly direction Witnesses and Driver 2 describe V01 as a black in color Chevrolet Silverado pickup truck with black wheels and black badges. This investigation will be considered pending unless more information for V01 and/or Driver 1 can be obtained.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was westbound in the inside lane of State Road 60 approaching a steady read light at Parsons Avenue. Vehicle 2 (V02) was southbound in the left turn lane of Parsons Avenue approaching a steady green left turn arrow at State Road 60. The driver of V01 proceeded forward past the steady red light and the front V01 struck the left front of V02. Both vehicles came to final rest in the intersection facing southwest. No skid marks were observed. Source of Transport to First Medical Facility: Other: D02 self-transported to Brandon Regional Hospital.

Vehicle 1 was traveling east on Flora Ave in the left turning lane, west of U.S. Hwy 19 (SR-55). Vehicle 2 was traveling west on Flora Ave, east of U.S. Hwy 19 (SR-55). Vehicle 1 turned left as Vehicle 2 was approaching. The front of Vehicle 2 struck the right side of Vehicle 1. Both vehicles relocated to the north shoulder of the westbound lanes of Flora Ave prior to Trooper arrival. Contributing Factors: Driver 1 failed to yield the right of way to oncoming traffic causing a crash.

Vehicle 1 was traveling west in the private parking lot of [ADDRESS] approaching Collier Pkwy. Vehicle 2 was traveling north on Collier Pkwy approaching the private drive of [ADDRESS] in the inside lane. Driver 1 failed to yield right of way to V2 while attempting to enter Collier Pkwy. As a result, the front of V1 collided with the right side of V2. After collision, both V1 and V2 relocated to the center grass median.

VEHICLE 1 WAS TRAVELING NORTHBOUND ON COMMERCIAL WAY AND MADE THE LEFT TURN TO HEAD WEST ON OSOWAW BLVD. VEHICLE 2 WAS TRAVELING SOUTHBOUND ON COMMERCIAL WAY IN THE OUTSIDE LANE. THE FRONT LEFT BUMPER OF VEHICLE 1 COLLIDED WITH THE LEFT REAR FENDER/TIRE OF VEHICLE 2 CAUSING MODERATE DAMAGE TO BOTH VEHICLES. DRIVER 1 ADVISED THAT SHE BELIEVED SHE HAD A GREEN TURN ARROW. DRIVER 2 ADVISED THAT HE HAD A GREEN LIGHT FOR THE STRAIGHT LANE. DRIVER 2 INDICATED THAT AN UNKNOWN WITNESS STOPPED AND INDICATED THAT DRIVER 1 HAD A RED TURN ARROW BUT THAT THE LIGHT WAS GREEN FOR THE STRAIGHT LANES. THE WITNESS LEFT PRIOR TO THE ARRIVAL OF LAW ENFORCEMENT AND DID NOT PROVIDE ANY INFORMATION. THERE ARE NO KNOWN WITNESSES AT THIS TIME. THERE WERE NO REPORTED INJURIES. THERE WERE NO PASSENGERS IN EITHER VEHICLE. BOTH VEHICLES WERE ABLE TO BE DRIVEN AWAY FROM THE SCENE. NO CITATIONS WERE ISSUED.

Vehicle 1 was at a complete stop facing east within a private parking lot entrance waiting to turn left onto Collier Pkwy. Vehicle 2 was traveling south in the inside lane of Collier Pkwy approaching the private parking lot entrance. Driver 1 attempted to turn left onto Collier Pkwy and proceeded towards the center median break as Vehicle 2 was approaching. The front left corner of Vehicle 1 struck the right side of Vehicle 2 within the roadway. Upon Trooper's arrival, Vehicle 1 had been relocated from area of collision to the parking lot on the west shoulder of Collier Pkwy. Vehicle 2 had been relocated to the center median break. Driver 1 was cited for violation of right of way from a stop sign.

V01 was stopped northbound for the posted stop sign on the driveway access of Aldi Grocery Store located at [ADDRESS], preparing to make a left turn onto Sunray Drive (west). V02 was traveling east on Sunray Drive in the inside lane approaching the driveway access of the Aldi Grocery Store, just west of US-19. Driver 01 failed to stay stopped at the stop sign and yield to the oncoming V02 and proceed only when safe to do so. Driver 01 proceeded to make a left turn across the eastbound lanes of Sunray Drive. As a result, V01 entered the direct path of V02 causing the front left corner of V01 to collide with the front right corner of V02. Both vehicles pulled onto the protected median opening prior to the investigator's arrival.

Vehicle 1 was stopped in the exit to the address of [ADDRESS] (Shell Gas Station) waiting to make a left turn onto Sunray Drive. Vehicle 2 was traveling west on Sunray Drive. Driver 1 failed to observe Vehicle 2 approaching and proceeded to make the turn. As a result the front of Vehicle 2 struck the left side of Vehicle 1. Both vehicles were removed from the area of collision prior to my arrival.

V01 was traveling west in the inside lane of westbound State Road 54, approaching the intersection of Collier Parkway. V02 was traveling east in the left turn lane of State Road 54, approaching Collier Parkway. V01 continued straight ahead into the intersection. V02 proceeded to make a left turn for northbound Collier Parkway. As a result, the front of V01 collided with the right side of V02. Post collision, V01 was redirected and came to final rest facing north. V02 was redirected and came to final rest facing west. Driver 1 stated that he had a green traffic signal to travel straight ahead. Driver 2 stated he had a steady green left turn signal to proceed with the left turn. Due to conflicting statements and no independent witness the at-fault vehicle/driver was undetermined.

V1 was stopped at North Parsons Ave with a red flashing traffic signal and proceeded through the intersection. On a yellow flashing traffic signal, V2 was stopped at West Brandon Blvd and proceeded with the traffic flow. V1 continued through the intersection while V2 and other vehicles proceeded through the intersection. V1 struck V2 on the driver-side front bumper, causing damage to V1's passenger-side front bumper. HCFR responded to the scene but did not take either driver. V1 passenger did state she had injuries but would go to the hospital afterward. I took photographs of the incident scene. I observed damage to both V1 and V2 near the front of their bumpers. A Driver Exchange was provided to both D1 and D2. V1 stated the following: He stopped at the light going northbound on Parsons and was halfway through the intersection when he observed V2 traveling at a fast rate of speed and then hit his front passenger-side bumper. V2 stated the following: He was in the middle lane going westbound on Brandon Blvd. He saw he had flashing yellow lights and stopped; he then proceeded with the traffic flow and observed V1 miss the other vehicles and strike his front bumper. He attempted to steer to the right to avoid the incident. W1 stated the following: She was at the Walgreens located at [ADDRESS] and noticed the lights had gone out at the intersection of E Brandon Blvd / N Parsons Ave. She kept watching because she was nervous an accident would occur. She observed V2 following the traffic flow and then noticed V1 go through the light in front of V2 and other vehicles in the intersection heading westbound on Brandon Blvd. She stated V1 struck V2, causing both vehicles to end up facing northbound on Parsons Ave. W2 stated the following: W2 stated the same as W1. This incident was captured on my body-worn camera. This concludes my involvement at this time.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling westbound on State Road 50 in the left turn lane approaching the intersection of County Road 587 with a steady red left turn traffic signal. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling eastbound on State Road 50 in the right through lane approaching the intersection of County Road 587 with a steady green traffic signal. Vehicle 3 (V03) was traveling eastbound on State Road 50 in the center lane approaching the intersection of County Road 587 with a steady green traffic signal Driver 1 (D01) stated when the traffic signal for the westbound through lanes on State Road 50 turned to a sold green she mistook this as her traffic signal also indicating she could turn left. D01 attempted to make a left turn at the intersection of State Road 50 and County Road 587. As V01 made it's left turn, it traveled into the outside northbound lane of US Highway 19, directly in front of V03 and V02. Subsequently, the front of V01 collided with the front of V02. Debris from the roadway possibly struck V03 as it drove on State Road 50 at the time of the collision. V01 rotated clockwise coming to final rest facing northbound in the intersection. V02 continued to the south shoulder on State Road 50 where it came to final rest.

Vehicle 1 was traveling westbound on State Road 50 (Cortez Blvd) in the left turn lane, west of County Road 587 (Mariner Blvd). Vehicle 2 was traveling eastbound on State Road 50, in the right turn lane, west of County Road 587. Driver 1 attempted to travel across the eastbound lanes of State Road 50, but failed to notice Vehicle 2 approaching. Vehicle 1 traveled into the direct path of Vehicle 2. The front of Vehicle 2 collided with the front right portion of Vehicle 1. Upon my arrival, Vehicle 1 was at final rest in the right turn lane facing southeast. Vehicle 2 was brought to a controlled stop on the right shoulder of State Road 50.

V-01 was traveling north on SR 55 (US 19) in the inside lane. V-02 was traveling south on SR 55 (US 19) in the left turn lane for Toucan Trail. Driver-1 stated that the traffic signal changed from yellow as she approached the intersection and then changed to red but she was going "too fast" to stop. Driver-2 stated that he entered the intersection on a steady yellow and proceeded into a left turn. Driver-2 stated that he observed at least two other vehicles traveling northbound stop prior to noticing V-01 collide with his vehicle. The right front of V-01 collided with the right rear corner of V-02 removing just the rear bumper of V-02. Upon my arrival both vehicles were in the process of moving toward the shoulder of the roadway with a civilian employee from the sheriff's office.

Vehicle 1 was traveling south in the inside lane of Collier Parkway approaching State Road 54. Vehicle 2 was traveling west in the center lane of State Road 54 appraoching Collier Parkway. Vehicle 3 was traveling west in the inside lane of State Road 54 appraoching Collier Parkway. Driver 1 failed to stop at the steady red light. As a result, the front left of Vehicle 1 struck the front right of Vehicle 2. Vehicle 2 was pushed into the inside lane, causing the front left to strike the right side of Vehicle 3. Vehicle 1 came to final rest within the center lane, facing west. Vehicles 2 and 3 were relocated to the median. Upon Trooper's arrival, all vehicles remained at rest.

NM1 was traveling westbound across US 19 (State Road 55) at the intersection of Flora Drive. V01 was traveling south on US 19 (State Road 55) approaching Flora Drive to a green signal. NM1 was crossing the roadway without any lighting and did not utilize the cross signal and entered into the outside lane. Driver 1 observed NM1 in the roadway and took evasive action by steering to the right to avoid colliding with NM1. As a result, the front wheel of NM1's bike collided into the driver's side front door of V01. V01 and NM1 were moved from final rest prior to my arrival. NM1 refused medical treatment and/or transport to a local hospital.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling north out of a private driveway located at [ADDRESS] approaching Sunray Drive. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling west on Sunray Drive approaching a private driveway located at [ADDRESS] in the outside lane. Driver 1 approached a stop sign, stopped and believing that the roadway was clear proceeded north to cross Sunray Drive to enter another private driveway on the other side of Sunray Drive. Driver 1 failed to observe V02 approaching from her right and as a result, the front of V02 collided with the passenger's side front fender of V01. V01 and V02 were moved from final rest to a nearby parking lot prior to my arrival.

Vehicle 1 was traveling north on U.S. Hwy 19 (SR-55) in the center lane approaching a red light, south of State Road 52. Vehicle 2 and Vehicle 3 were traveling south on U.S Hwy 19 (SR-55) in the left turning lane, north of State Road 52. Vehicle 2 was ahead of Vehicle 3. Vehicle 2 and Vehicle 3 turned left (southeast). Vehicle 1 ran the steady red light as Vehicle 2 was approaching. The front of Vehicle 2 struck the front left of Vehicle 1. Vehicle 1 traveled northeast an came to final rest in the northeast corner of the intersection facing north. Vehicle 2 began to rotate counterclockwise. The front of Vehicle 3 struck Vehicle 2. Vehicle 2 traveled northeast and came to final rest in the intersection facing northeast. Vehicle 3 relocated off the roadway prior to my arrival.

Vehicle 1 was traveling south on U.S.19 (SR-55) in the left turn lane, north of Fox Hollow Drive, approaching a red traffic signal. Vehicle 2 was traveling north on U.S.19 in the inside lane, south of Fox Hollow Drive, approaching a green traffic signal. Vehicle 1 began to make the left turn as Vehicle 2 was approaching causing Vehicle 2 to swerve to the outside lane to try to avoid the collision. The front of Vehicle 1 struck the left side of Vehicle 2. Vehicle 1 came to final rest facing east in the intersection. Vehicle 2 was removed from the area of collision prior to my arrival. A deputy with the Pasco County Sheriff's Office arrived on-scene right after the crash occurred and saw three Hispanic males running from Vehicle 1. He did not see who the driver was but he was able to catch two of the occupants. Neither individual would admit to being the driver. Dispatch was able to get a hold of the owner of the vehicle who advised that he also did not know who was driving.

V01 was southbound on US 19 SR 55 in the left lane approaching the intersection of Spring Hill Dr. V02 was westbound on Spring Hill Dr in the inside left turn lane approaching the US 19 intersection. V03 was westbound on Spring Hill Dr in the outside left turn lane approaching the US 19 intersection. V01 failed to stop at the steady red light, entering the intersection on a red light. V02 and V03 began to negotiate a left turn on a green arrow. The right front corner of V02 struck the left side (driver door area) of V01. Due to impact, V02 was pushed into the outside left turn lane occupied by V03. The left side of V02 struck the right front corner of V03. Prior to my arrival all vehicles were moved from the area of collision.

Vehicle-1 (V01) was traveling westbound in the private driveway of Crunch Fitness located at [ADDRESS], approaching the north and southbound travel lanes of Collier Parkway. Vehicle-2 (V02) was traveling southbound in the outside lane of Collier Parkway, approaching the intersection of State Road 54. Driver-1 stated that a vehicle in the southbound inside lane stopped and waved for him to enter the roadway. Driver-1 then accelerated and steered V01 in a southwest direction and entered the outside lane, which was occupied by V02. As a result the front of V01 struck the left side of V02. V01 and V02 were moved from the area of collision to the southbound outside turn lane of Collier parkway and were both facing south, upon Trooper's arrival. V01 and V02 were still functional. Driver-1 and Driver-2 refused to be transported by Pasco County EMS.

V01 was traveling southbound in the driveway of The Home Depot located at [ADDRESS], approaching Flora Avenue. V02 was traveling westbound on Flora Avenue, approaching the driveway of The Home Depot located at [ADDRESS]. There is a stop sign at the driveway of The Home Depot and Flora Avenue. The front left corner of V01 struck the front of V02. Both vehicles were relocated from the area of collision to Dunedin Floors and Granite located at [ADDRESS], prior to my arrival. Vehicle 1 (V01) was stopped at the stop sign facing north in the RaceTrac gas station driveway located at [ADDRESS]. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling west on Fox Hollow Drive just east of the RaceTrac gas station driveway located at the aforementioned address. V01 began to make a left turn resulting in the front end of V01 striking the left side of V02. All vehicles were moved from final rest prior to my arrival.

V01 was eastbound in the left turn lane on State Road 54, approaching the intersection of [ADDRESS] Village Lakes Shopping Center. V02 was westbound in the outside lane on State Road 54, approaching the intersection of [ADDRESS] Village Lakes Shopping Center. The witness and Driver-01 stated that both vehicles' traffic signal was just cycled to yellow. V01 began to make a left turn lane. Driver -01 failed to observe V02 traveling west, and the front of V02 struck the right side of V01. V01 then began to rotate counterclockwise, and the right side of V01 struck the left side of V02. V01 came to final rest facing northwest at the entrance of [ADDRESS] Village Lakes Shopping Center and remained at final rest upon my arrival. V02 came to final rest facing north at the entrance of [ADDRESS] Village Lakes Shopping Center and remained at final rest upon my arrival.

V01 was in the inside southbound left turn lane of US Highway 19 (State Road) waiting to make a left turn on to the private driveway of [ADDRESS]. V02 was traveling northbound in the outside right turn lane approaching the intersection of the private driveway at [ADDRESS]. V03 was stopped in traffic in the northbound outside lane of US Highway 19 just north of the intersection of the private driveway of [ADDRESS]. Based on Statements from Driver-1, northbound traffic was stopped leaving enough of a gap between vehicles for him to cross the inside, center and outside through lanes of US Highway 19. V01 crossed the all three lanes. As Driver-1 attempted to cross the outside right turn lane he began to move in to the lane slowly. As the front of V01 entered the outside right turn lane, Driver-2 observed V01 enter the lane but was unable to stop V02 before colliding with V01. The front left of V02 collided with the front right of V01. The force from the impact between V01 and V02 caused the V01 to turn counter clock wise facing north. As V01 turned an moved forward left of V02 struck the rear of V03. At the time of this Trooper's arrival all vehicles were moved off the roadway and onto the northbound shoulder of US Highway 19. Driver-2 was not present as she was transported to the hospital by EMS prior to Troopers arrival. Contributing Cause - Driver-1 failed to yield to on coming traffic as they attempted to cross the northbound lanes of traffic. Driver-1 was cited for failure to yield to on coming traffic.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was stopped in the Publix parking lot access at [ADDRESS], facing south, east of U.S. 19 (State Road 55). Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling westbound on Sunray Drive, east of U.S. 19 (State Road 55). Driver 1 stated that there was large palm frond in the roadway. She stated that she attempted to make a left turn onto eastbound Sunray Drive, and maneuvered around the palm frond. She also stated that the driver of a stopped vehicle facing east "waved her on". In doing so, Driver 1 violated Driver 2's right of way. As a result, the left front of V02 collided with the rear left and undercarriage (wheel) of V01. Post-impact, V01 rotated counterclockwise and came to final rest facing north, on the southern grass shoulder of Sunray Drive. V02 was relocated to the southern grass shoulder of Sunray Drive, prior to my arrival.

Vehicle-1 (V01) was traveling southbound in the center lane of US-19 (State Road 55), approaching the intersection of Sunray Drive. Vehicle-2 (V02) was traveling northbound in the inside turn lane of US-19, approaching the intersection of Sunray Drive. At the time the traffic signal for V01 was solid red, and the traffic signal for V02 was a green turn arrow. Driver-1 stopped V01 for the red traffic signal ahead. Driver-2 began to perform a left turn in order to travel west of Sunray Drive. Driver-1 stated that he believed the traffic signal turned green and began to accelerate V01 forward into the intersection, which was occupied by V02. As a result the front of V01 struck the right side of V02. V01 and V02 were moved from the area of collision to the north shoulder of Sunray Drive, prior to Trooper's arrival. V01 and V02 were facing west. V02 was removed by All Hour Towing due to disabling damage. There are two independent witnesses to the above collision.

veh 1 was turning onto cortez blvd to head west from mariner blvd. veh 2 was waiting at the traffic light on cortez blvd heading east. veh 1 was negotiating the turn and due to wet road conditions, the vehicle began to slide across the road causing the front of veh 1 to hit the side of veh 2. no injuries, veh 2 towed by dun roman.

V01 was traveling south in the left-turn lane on US 19 (State Rd 55), approaching Sunray Dr. V02 was traveling north in the outside lane on US 19 (State Rd 55), approaching Sunray Dr. V01 failed to obey a steady red traffic control signal and turned left into the intersection as V02 was in the intersection. As a result, the front of V02 struck the rear right of V01. V01 rotated clockwise and began to overturn. V02 continued north. V01 came to final rest facing south west in the southeast side of the intersection. V02 came to final rest on the east shoulder of US 19, north of the intersection. Upon Trooper's arrival, Trooper spoke with Driver 2. He stated that they were stopped at the intersection and as the light turned green, and that is when V01 entered the intersection resulting in the collision. Trooper spoke to Driver 1, she stated that she was traveling south, and she stalled V01. When Driver 1 got V01 started she continued through the intersection with a steady red traffic control signal. Contributing Cause: Driver 1 failed to obey a steady red traffic control signal resulting in the collision.

V-01 was traveling east on Osowaw Blvd. in the outside lane to travel straight ahead and continue on Spring Hill Drive. V-02 was traveling west on Spring Hill Drive in the outside left turn lane to travel south on US 19. Driver-1 stated that her signal was green as she approached the intersection and collided with a vehicle that came out of "nowhere." Driver-2 stated that her signal was red and she was stopped behind other traffic. Driver-2 stated that when her signal turned green, she proceeded into her left turn along with the traffic ahead of her. Upon proceeding into the left turn, the front of V-01 collided with the right side of V-02. Based on statements or the lack thereof, this investigator believes that Driver 1 mistook the left turn green arrow as her signal and ran the red signal. Upon my arrival, both vehicles were parked on the grass shoulder of southbound US 19.

V2 was northbound on Mt. Carmel Rd from State Rd 60. V1 was attempting to make a left (south) turn out of the private business at 131 Mt. Carmel Rd. V1 failed to observe V2 in the roadway as she entered the lane of travel. The front of V1 impacted the right (passenger) side of V2. No airbags deployed in this crash. Both vehicles were able to be driven from the scene.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling northbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the outside lane, south of State Road 52. Vehicle 2 (V02) was stopped, northbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the outside lane, south of State Road 52. Vehicle 3 (V03) was traveling northbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the outside lane, south of State Road 52, directly ahead of V02. Vehicle 4 (V04) was traveling northbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the outside lane, south of State Road 52, directly ahead of V04. Drivers 3 and 4 both stated that the traffic light ahead had just turned turned from red to green, and that they each had just begun to accelerate. Driver 2 stated that he felt a "boom", and that he was then struck by a portion of V01. He stated that V01 then "spun" past him, such that it also struck the rear right corner of V03 and the rear undercarriage of V4. This is based upon the statement of Driver 2, and the apparent damage to each vehicle. However, both Driver 3 and Driver 4 were not totally certain of how the crash physically occurred. Vehicles 1 and 2 remained at final rest in the roadway, upon my arrival. Vehicles 3 and 4 were relocated off of the roadway, prior to my arrival. Drivers 2, and 4 stated that prior to the crash, south of its location, they had observed V01 traveling at an inappropriately low rate of speed, and swerving all over the road. They also stated that after the crash, they approached V01, and observed Driver 1 behind the wheel. They stated that he "appeared to be out of it", and that at one point, he began to convulse. When I was on scene gathering information, paramedic [NAME] (Pasco County EMS) administered Narcan to Driver 1. Driver 1 then awoke, and was transported to Regional Medical Bayonet Point.

V01 was traveling west in the left turn lane of westbound State Road 54, at the intersection of Village Lakes Shopping Center Drive. V02 was traveling east in the center lane of eastbound State Road 54, approaching the intersection of Village Lakes Shopping Center Drive. V01 proceeded to turn left and traveled into the path of V02. As a result, the right side of V01's trailer collided with the front of V02. Post collision, V01 came to final rest in the entrance to Lowe's. V02 came to final rest along the south shoulder of eastbound State Road 54, east of the intersection. Driver 1 stated at the time of the traffic crash, the westbound left turn lane had a flashing yellow arrow. Driver 2 and the witness stated the straight lanes of eastbound State Road 54 had steady solid green traffic signals.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling west in a private driveway at [ADDRESS] approaching Collier Parkway. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling south on Collier Parkway approaching State Road 54 in the outside lane. Driver 1 approached the intersection and believing there was sufficient time and and distance, initiated a left turn in front of V02. Driver 2 observed that V01 was crossing the path of V02 and believing a crash was imminent took evasive action by steering to the right. Driver 2 over steered V02 and as a result the passenger's side front wheel collided with the curb on the right shoulder. Due to the collision with the curb, V02 was redirected to the left resulting in the driver's side front fender of V02 colliding with the front driver's door of V01. V02 came to final rest in the outside lane southbound Collier Parkway north of State Road 54 in the outside lane. V01 was moved from final rest to Collier Parkway north of State Road 54 in the outside lane.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling east approaching a stop sign in the parking lot of [ADDRESS] 54. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling north in the parking lot of [ADDRESS] 54 approaching the area V01 was traveling to. Driver 1 stopped before proceeding out from the stop sign. Driver 1 failed to observe V02 approaching northbound. V01 entered the direct path of V02. As a result, there was a collision. The front right side of V01 struck the left side of V02. Both vehicles were at a controlled stop in the parking lot prior to Trooper's arrival.

([PLATE] 2006 Mercedes-Benz, E-Class), listed as V1 ([PLATE] 2013 Subaru Impreza), listed as V2 On [DATE], at [TIME], I responded US Highway 19 and State Road 52, Hudson, Florida, regarding a traffic crash. Vehicle 1 was traveling on the left turn lane of southbound Mt Carmel Road at the intersection of SR-60. Vehicle 2 was traveling on northbound Mt Carmel Road at the intersection of SR-60. Driver 1 advised she observed the traffic control signal cycle to a steady green circle. Driver 1 advised she began to perform the left turn and then observed Vehicle 2 approaching from the oncoming travel lanes. Driver 1 advised she attempted to rapidly slow her vehicle to avoid a collision but was unsuccessful. As a result, the front left of Vehicle 1 collided into the front left of Vehicle 2. Driver 2 advised she observed the traffic control signal to be a steady green circle. Driver 2 advised she entered the intersection and then observed Vehicle 1 attempting a left turn. Driver 2 advised she was unable to avoid the collision. As a result, the front left of Vehicle 1 collided into the front left of Vehicle 2. Vehicle 1 and 2 were moved from the area of collision into a nearby parking lot prior to my arrival.

V01 was traveling westbound in the left turn lane on State Road 60, approaching the intersection of Mount Carmel. V02 was traveling eastbound in the outside center lane on State Road 60, approaching the intersection of Mount Carmel. V03 was traveling northbound in the outside left turn lane on Mount Carmel, approaching the intersection of State Road 60. V04 was traveling northbound on Mount Carmel, approaching the intersection of State Road 60. Driver-1 stated she thought she had enough time to go through and noticed the light was red last minute. Driver-2 stated he was driving his traffic signal was green and the vehicle made a left turn in front of him. Driver-3 and Driver-4 stated they did not see what happen and then felt the impact and the vehicle was on top on them. The front end of V02 struck the right rear side of V01. The collision pushed V01 in a southeast direction of travel and V01 collided and came to final rest on top of V03 and V04. V03 and V04 remained at the area of collision facing north. V01 continued to travel in a southeast direction and traveled off the roadway onto the curb and came to final rest against the traffic pole causing no damage to the pole.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling north in the northbound outside lane of US 19 (SR 55) approaching the intersection with Citrus Dr. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling west on Citrus Drive entering the intersection with US 19. V01 failed to stop at the traffic control signal at the intersection of US 19 and Citrus Drive. As V01 entered the intersection with a steady red light, the front of V01 collided with the left side of V02. Witness 01 (W01) stated that she was sitting at the red traffic control signal and saw V01 run the red light. [SENTENCE REMOVED]. When asked what lane he was traveling in, D01 pointed to the outside northbound lane. D01's son said he was going about 45 miles per hour. Driver 02 (D02) stated he was leaving the gas station on the east side of the road and heading back home. As V02 entered the intersection heading west, D02 said he proceeded to go straight and there was a red car to the left of him that was turning left that D02 believes stopped and was able to avoid being struck, but D02 did not see V01. V01 came to final rest facing northwest in the intersection of US 19 and Citrus Drive facing northwest in the northbound side of the intersection. V02 came to final rest facing west in the northbound side of the intersection.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was stopped northbound on Parsons Avenue in the intersection of State Road 60 (W Brandon Blvd) waiting to turn left. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling south on Parsons Avenue north of State Road 60 (W Brandon Blvd) in the thru lane. The traffic signal for both north and southbound Parsons Avenue changed from green to yellow. V01 proceeded to turn left in front of V02. V02 saw the traffic signal changing from green to yellow. V02 failed to slow and stop at a yellow traffic signal. The front of V02 struck the right front corner of V01. V01 rotated counterclockwise and came to final rest facing southwest in the eastbound lanes of State Road 60, west of Parsons Avenue. V02 rotated clockwise and came to final rest facing southwest in the eastbound lanes of State Road 60 (W Brandon Blvd) west of the point of impact. Notes: V02 was moved into the parking lot on the southeast corner of the intersection prior to my arrival. V01 remained in the roadway upon my arrival. V02 driver stated he could not stop at the yellow traffic signal. V01 should not have been in the intersection waiting for the light to change prior to turning left.

V01 was eastbound on SR-60 (Brandon Blvd) approaching Mt Carmel Road in the outside lane. V02 was southbound on Mt. Carmel approaching SR-60 (Brandon Blvd). As V02 entered the intersection, V01 entered the intersection the front of V01 struck the right side of V02. Both vehicles relocated to a nearby parking lot. D01 stated that her traffic light was red and turn to green. D02 advise that his traffic light was green. Due to contradicting statements, lack of evidence, no surveillance footage, and independent witnesses, neither driver was found at fault or cited for the crash.

Vehicle 1 was traveling southbound from a private drive turning right to travel west on SR 60. Vehicle 2 was traveling westbound on SR 60 west of Mount Carmel Rd. Driver 1 of Vehicle 1 failed to yield to the right way of Vehicle 2. The left front of Vehicle 1 collided with the right front of Vehicle 2. Vehicle 1 came to final rest facing northeast in the inside and inside center lane. Vehicle 2 came to final rest in the left turn lane westbound. There were no pre or post collision markings observed on the roadway associated with this crash. There were no injuries.

V01 was traveling northbound in the left turn lane on Parsons Boulevard, approaching the intersection of State Road 60(Brandon Boulevard). V02 was traveling southbound on Parsons Boulevard, approaching the intersection of State Road 60(Brandon Boulevard). The traffic signal for north and southbound lanes was steady green. Driver-1 attempted to make a left turn and traveled into the path of V02. The front end of V02 struck the right front end of V01. V01 came to final rest in the intersection facing westbound. V02 came to final rest in the intersection facing westbound. Video at Muffler and Pipes showed V01 making a left turn in front of V02.

Vehicle-1 (V-1) was in the left turn lane on westbound State Road 54 at the Lowe's Access Road intersection. Vehicle-2 (V-2) was in the outside lane traveling on eastbound State Road 54 approaching the Lowe's Access Road intersection. According to witnesses, the Driver of V-1 entered the intersection on a flashing yellow arrow traffic control device and attempted a left turn entering the direct path of eastbound traffic causing the front and front right of V-2 to collide with the center to rear right side of V-1. Due to impact caused V-2 to rotate clockwise into final rest. V-1 and V-2 both were moved from final rest to the bike lane, curbed shoulder, and sidewalk area along the eastbound side of State Road 54 just east of the Lowe's Access Road intersection prior to arrival. Additional Information: One witness was located directly behind V-1 and stated the traffic control device was a flashing yellow arrow facing westbound while V-1 attempted a turn from the intersection into Lowe's Access Road. The witness stated she observed V-2 approaching and feared there would be a collision, in which did ultimately occur. The second witness was located directly at the intersection stopped at the right turn exit lane on Lowe's Access Road just south of State Road 54. The witness observed V-1 enter the intersection then observed V-2 approaching the intersection with a solid green traffic control device. The witness stated V-1 turned into V-2's direct path of travel causing the collision.

V02 was traveling north on US HWY 19 in the middle lane approaching SR-52. V01 was traveling west on SR-52 approaching US Hwy 19 in the outside lane. Both V01 & V02 came to a stop at the light due to the traffic lights malfunctioning. V01 & V02 entered the intersection at the same time failing to yield to each other. As a result, V01's front right bumper area collided with V02's front left drivers side area. Both V01 & V02 collided with enough force that the energy carried both vehicles to the crosswalk, just north of the intersection of US HWY 19 & SR-52 where both V01 & V02 came to a final rest. Both V01 & V02 were located where they came to final rest upon my arrival.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling south on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the left turn lane, south of State Road 52. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling north on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the right turn lane, south of State Road 52. Driver 1 attempted to make a left turn into the La Vista Inn parking lot entrance, but failed to yield the right of way to Driver 2. As a result, the front of V02 collided with the rear right of V01. Both vehicles were relocated to nearby parking lots, upon my arrival.

V01 was traveling south in the southbound lanes on US-19 approaching Innisbrook Dr. V02 was traveling east in the eastbound lanes on Innisbrook Dr, through the intersection with US-19. Driver 1 stated that she believed the light was green on her approach, but just before her entering the intersection she realized multiple vehicles were traveling east and west through the intersection, with green lights eastbound and westbound. Driver 1 failed to stop at a steady red signal. The front of V01 collided with the left side of V02. Prior to my arrival, both vehicles were moved out of the intersection to clear it.

Vehicle 1 was westbound on Citrus Drive in the left turn lane at US-19 (SR-55). Vehicle 1 was facing a steady red traffic signal. Vehicle 2 was northbound on US-19 (SR-55) in the inside lane at the intersection of Citrus Drive. Vehicle 2 was facing a steady green traffic signal. Vehicle 1 entered the intersection to conduct a left-hand turn, subsequently entering the path of vehicle 2, in violation of the red traffic signal. The front left of vehicle 2 collided with the left rear of vehicle 1. Post-collision, vehicle 2 rotated counter-clockwise while moving in a southwest direction, coming to final rest facing northwest in the outside lane of US-19 southbound. Vehicle 2 was brought to a controlled stop and was relocated to the southeast corner of the intersection prior to law enforcement arrival. Witness 1 stated that she was northbound on US-19, south of Citrus Drive, in the center lane behind and to the right of vehicle 2. Witness 1 confirmed that she and vehicle 2 were facing a steady green traffic signal at the time she observed vehicle 1 enter the intersection. Witness 2 advised that he was southbound on US-19, north of Citrus Drive, in the middle lane. Witness 2 stated that he was facing a steady green traffic signal and that he was still facing that signal at the time he observed vehicle 1 enter the intersection.

V01 was traveling westbound in the inside turn lane of Flora Avenue, approaching the intersection of US-19 (State Road 55). V02 was traveling eastbound on Flora Avenue, approaching the intersection of US-19. Driver-2 continued to travel eastbound and entered the intersection of US-19. Driver-1 began to perform a left turn into the intersection of US-19, which was occupied by V02. As a result the front right side of V02 struck the right side front of V01. V01 and V02 remained at the area of collision and were causing road block, upon Trooper's arrival. V01 and V02 were removed from the scene by Pasco Towing due to disabling damage. Driver-2 and the front seat passenger of V02 were transported to Advent Health North Pinellas Hospital by Pasco County EMS due to injuries caused by the collision.

V01 was stopped in the eastbound left turn lane of State Road 54, intersecting with Village Lakes Shopping Drive. V02 was traveling westbound in the inside lane of State Road 54, approaching the intersection of Village Lakes Shopping Drive. Based on statements from Driver 1, as she was stopped in the left turn lane, the traffic control signal had a flashing yellow arrow for the left turn lane. Driver 1 stated that traffic in the westbound lanes was stopped, and she believed it was safe to cross the westbound lanes of traffic turning onto Village Lakes Shopping Drive. As V01 entered the inside westbound lane, she failed to observe V02 approaching. Driver 2 attempted to stop V02 to avoid a collision with V01 but could not. The front right of V02 collided with the right rear side of V01. At the time of Trooper's arrival, V01 was at final rest in the westbound outside lane of State Road 54 just north of the intersection. V02 was parked on the westbound sidewalk of State Road 54 just north of the intersection. Contributing Cause: Driver 1 failed to yield to oncoming traffic, resulting in a collision. Driver 1 was cited for failure to yield to oncoming traffic.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was traveling northbound on U.S. 19 (State Road 55), in the outside lane, approaching Embassy Blvd. Vehicle 2 (V02) was traveling westbound on Embassy Blvd., in the outside left turn lane, at U.S. 19 (State Road 55). Based upon available physical evidence, it appear as if Driver 1 failed to stop a the red traffic signal, and entered the intersection. Driver 2 faced a green traffic signal, and entered the intersection, turning left. As a result, the front of V01 collided with the left side of V02. Both vehicles were removed from the roadway, upon my arrival. When I spoke to Driver 1, he stated that he "couldn't stop in time". As well, an EMS supervisor that was on scene stated to me that he was "behind the Kia, a few cars back". He stated that the westbound traffic on Embassy Blvd. faced a green traffic signal.

On [DATE], at approximately [TIME], V2 was traveling west bound on State Road 60. V1 was traveling north bound on North Saint Cloud Avenue. The witness was traveling east bound on State Road 60. Approaching the intersection, V2 entered to cross, when V1 disobeyed the traffic control device and struck V2 causing disabling damage to both vehicles. V1 came to final rest facing north bound on north Saint Cloud Avenue. V2 came to final rest in the middle of the intersection facing north. The independent witness observed the aforementioned. Hillsborough County Fire Engine and Rescue/ [ID], Rescue 45 and rescue 18 ([CASE NUMBER]) responded to the scene. V1D1 was complaining of chest pain and was transported to Tampa General Hospital. V1 Passenger had high blood pressure and was transported to Tampa General Hospital. V2D2 did not get transported. VH-2 WAS MAKING THE LEFT TURN FROM OSOWAW BLVD TO HEAD NORTH ONTO COMMERCIAL WAY. VH-1 WAS TRAVELING WESTBOUND ON SPRING HILL DR APPROACHING THE INTERSECTION OF COMMERCIAL WAY. DUE TO VH-1 RUNNING THE RED LIGHT, VH-1 STRUCK VH-2'S RIGHT FRONT PASSENGER SIDE WITH ITS FRONT CENTER BUMPER CAUSING DISABLING DAMAGE TO BOTH VEHICLE. DR-1 ADMITTED TO NOT PAYING ATTENTION AND RUNNING THE RED LIGHT.

On [DATE] at approximately [TIME]. I was dispatched to the intersection of commercial way and Spring Hill Dr. in reference to a traffic accident. Upon arrival I observed a gray Dodge journey referred to his vehicle 1 that was discovered to have been piloted by [NAME]. With [NAME] as a front seat passenger. This vehicle was heavily damaged on the front end and was about a quarter of the way through the intersection with front of the vehicle facing northbound on commercial way. I also observed a black Chevrolet pickup truck referred to as vehicle 2 discovered to have been piloted by [NAME] with [NAME] as a front seat passenger and [NAME] as a rear right seat passenger. This vehicle had heavy damage on the right hand center of the vehicle where both right hand doors had been crushed and the running board had been peeled straight down. The vehicle appeared to have been spun and was now facing south west in the intersection near the median of Spring Hill Dr. also on scene were [NAME] and [NAME]. Both of these parties had witnessed the accident and informed me that the black truck was making a left-hand turn onto Spring Hill Dr. from commercial way, they stated that they had observed the grey journey enter the intersection ignoring the red traffic signal and collide with the black pickup truck. Then spoke with all parties in the black pickup truck who confirmed this account of events. I then spoke with the occupants in need Dodge journey who stated the light had turned quickly and they don't attempted to stop but due to what conditions had slid into the intersection and collided with truck. [NAME] was issued a traffic citation AE69JWE in reference to failing to obey a traffic signal resulting in a crash. A copy of the citation was entered into records The black pickup truck was removed from the scene by [NAME] and placed in a nearby parking lot. The Dodge journey was removed by the scene by Tates towing, who is a rotational towing service. A tow slip was completed and entered into records. Once the scene was cleared the occupants of the black pickup truck were driven to their hotel which was nearby.

Vehicle 1 (V1) was westbound on US Highway 19 Alternate in the inside lane, just west of US Highway 19. Non-Motorist 1 (NM01) was dartinng across westbound US Highway 19 Alternate, running from Pasco County Sheriff's Office (PCSO) Deputy [NAME]. PCSO attempted to approach NM01 due to him panhandling in the area. The left front of V1 struck NM01. Both NM01 and V01 were removed from the roadway prior to my arrival.

Vehicle 1 (V01) was westbound on State Road 50 in the outside left turn lane, stopped at a steady red left turn arrow at the intersection of Mariner Boulevard. Vehicle 2 (V02) was eastbound on State Road 50 in the center lane, approaching a steady green traffic light at the intersection of Mariner Boulevard. Vehicle 3 (V03) was northbound on Mariner Boulevard in the outside left turn lane, stopped at a steady red traffic light at the intersection of State Road 50. Vehicle 4 (V04) was northbound on Mariner Boulevard in the center lane stopped at a steady red traffic light at the intersection of State Road 50, directly beside V03. The driver of V01 drove through the red light and attempted to make a left turn onto Mariner Boulevard, entering into the direct path of V02. As a result, the front of V02 struck the right side of V01. V01 then rotated counter-clockwise and began traveling in a southeasterly direction. The front right side of V01 then struck the front left side of V03. As a result of this collision, V03 rotated clockwise. The front right side of V03 then struck the left side of V04. V01 came to final rest facing southeast across the northbound lanes of Mariner Boulevard, still in contact with V03. V02 came to final rest facing southwest in the intersection of State Road 50 and Mariner Boulevard.
